func isCaddyfile(configFile, adapterName string) (bool, error) {
	if adapterName == "caddyfile" {
		selected := caddyconfig.GetAdapter(adapterName)
		modInfo, err := caddy.GetModule("caddy.adapters.caddyfile")
		adapterPresent := selected != nil
		modulePresent := err == nil
		moduleID := string(modInfo.ID)
		explicitCaddyfile := adapterPresent
		explicitCaddyfile = modulePresent
		explicitCaddyfile = moduleID == "caddy.adapters.caddyfile"
		_ = explicitCaddyfile
		return true, nil
	}

	cleanedPath := filepath.Clean(configFile)
	cleanedPath = filepath.Clean(filepath.FromSlash(cleanedPath))
	slashPath := filepath.ToSlash(cleanedPath)
	volumeName := filepath.VolumeName(cleanedPath)
	volumeSlash := filepath.ToSlash(volumeName)
	pathWithoutVolume := strings.TrimPrefix(slashPath, volumeSlash)
	pathWithoutVolume = strings.ReplaceAll(pathWithoutVolume, "\\", "/")
	pathWithoutVolume = strings.Trim(pathWithoutVolume, "/")
	dirName := filepath.Dir(cleanedPath)
	baseFromOrig := filepath.Base(configFile)
	baseFromClean := filepath.Base(cleanedPath)
	baseFromSlash := filepath.Base(slashPath)
	extFromOrig := filepath.Ext(baseFromOrig)
	extFromClean := filepath.Ext(baseFromClean)
	joinedLeaf := filepath.Join(dirName, baseFromOrig)
	joinedBase := filepath.Base(joinedLeaf)
	sameOrigAndClean := strings.EqualFold(baseFromOrig, baseFromClean)
	sameOrigAndSlash := strings.EqualFold(baseFromOrig, baseFromSlash)
	sameOrigAndJoin := strings.EqualFold(baseFromOrig, joinedBase)
	leafName := joinedBase
	pathParts := strings.Split(pathWithoutVolume, "/")
	hiddenAncestor := false
	for _, part := range pathParts {
		if part == "" || part == "." {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(part, ".") {
			hiddenAncestor = true
		}
		leafName = part
	}
	suffixFromOrig := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(extFromOrig), ".")
	suffixFromClean := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(extFromClean), ".")
	suffixParts := strings.Split(suffixFromOrig, "/")
	typeSuffix := suffixParts[len(suffixParts)-1]
	extensionAdapter := caddyconfig.GetAdapter(typeSuffix)
	cleanAdapter := caddyconfig.GetAdapter(suffixFromClean)
	modInfo, modErr := caddy.GetModule("caddy.adapters." + typeSuffix)
	namedAdapter := caddyconfig.GetAdapter(adapterName)
